Security.description: Settings of the security HTTP headers. These values override the ones configured in the admin settings, and they are only applied when the 'ConfigureSecuritySettings()' extension method is called on the OrchardCoreBuilder. See https://docs.orchardcore.net/en/latest/reference/modules/Security/.

ContentSecurityPolicy.description: The directives of the 'Content-Security-Policy' HTTP header, keyed by directive name, with the directive value as value, e.g. "'self' https://cdn.example.com". When the configuration is applied, these directives replace the ones configured in the admin settings.

base-uri.description: Restricts the URLs that can be used in the <base> element of the page.

child-src.description: Restricts the sources of web workers and nested browsing contexts, like frames.

connect-src.description: Restricts the URLs that can be loaded by script interfaces like fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket and EventSource.

default-src.description: The fallback sources for the fetch directives that are not defined.

form-action.description: Restricts the URLs that can be used as the target of form submissions.

frame-ancestors.description: Restricts the parents that can embed the page in a frame. This directive obsoletes the 'X-Frame-Options' HTTP header.

frame-src.description: Restricts the sources of nested browsing contexts, like frames.

manifest-src.description: Restricts the sources of application manifests.

media-src.description: Restricts the sources of audio and video.

object-src.description: Restricts the sources of plugins loaded by the <object> and <embed> elements.

report-uri.description: The URL where the browser reports the violations of the policy.

sandbox.description: Applies restrictions to the page like a sandboxed iframe. The value lists the allowed exceptions, e.g. 'allow-forms allow-scripts', or is empty to apply all the restrictions.

upgrade-insecure-requests.description: Instructs the browser to upgrade the insecure (HTTP) URLs of the page to HTTPS. The value is ignored.

ContentTypeOptions.description: The value of the 'X-Content-Type-Options' HTTP header.

PermissionsPolicy.description: The features of the 'Permissions-Policy' HTTP header, keyed by feature name, with the allowlist of the feature as value: 'self', '*', or a space-separated list of origins that may include 'self', e.g. 'self https://www.example.com'. A feature with the '()' value is omitted from the header. When the configuration is applied, these features replace the ones configured in the admin settings.

accelerometer.description: Controls the use of the accelerometer sensor.

ambient-light-sensor.description: Controls the use of the ambient light sensor.

autoplay.description: Controls whether media can play automatically.

battery.description: Controls the use of the Battery Status API.

camera.description: Controls the use of video input devices.

display-capture.description: Controls the capture of the screen contents.

document-domain.description: Controls the use of the document.domain setter.

encrypted-media.description: Controls the use of the Encrypted Media Extensions API.

fullscreen.description: Controls the use of the fullscreen mode.

gamepad.description: Controls the use of the Gamepad API.

geolocation.description: Controls the use of the Geolocation API.

gyroscope.description: Controls the use of the gyroscope sensor.

layout-animations.description: Controls the animation of the layout properties.

legacy-image-format.description: Controls the display of images in legacy formats.

magnetometer.description: Controls the use of the magnetometer sensor.

microphone.description: Controls the use of audio input devices.

midi.description: Controls the use of the Web MIDI API.

oversized-images.description: Controls the display of images larger than their container.

payment.description: Controls the use of the Payment Request API.

picture-in-picture.description: Controls the playback of videos in picture-in-picture mode.

publickey-credentials-get.description: Controls the retrieval of public key credentials through the Web Authentication API.

speaker-selection.description: Controls the selection of audio output devices.

screen-wake-lock.description: Controls the use of the Screen Wake Lock API.

sync-xhr.description: Controls the use of synchronous XMLHttpRequest requests.

unoptimized-images.description: Controls the display of unoptimized images.

unsized-media.description: Controls the display of media elements without explicit dimensions.

usb.description: Controls the use of the WebUSB API.

web-share.description: Controls the use of the Web Share API.

xr-spatial-tracking.description: Controls the use of the WebXR Device API.

ReferrerPolicy.description: The value of the 'Referrer-Policy' HTTP header: 'no-referrer', 'no-referrer-when-downgrade', 'origin', 'origin-when-cross-origin', 'same-origin', 'strict-origin', 'strict-origin-when-cross-origin' or 'unsafe-url'.

OrchardCore_Security.deprecationMessage: The 'OrchardCore_Security' section is deprecated. Use 'OrchardCore:Security' instead.
